name: Ilava (Slovakia)
description: Ten equal horizontal stripes of white, white, blue, blue, red, red, blue, blue, white and white, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature I-2/1991.
